item.title: Bids Invited for Rolling Stock Contract of Delhi Metro Phase 4
item.description: NEW DELHI (Metro Rail News): Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) has invited bids for the rolling stock Contract RS20 of Delhi Metro Phase 4.
